meta.critical_rule: REDESIGN VISUALS ONLY. Do not touch any logic, functions, event handlers, state, routing, localStorage operations, WhatsApp links, analytics tracking, or admin authentication. Every functional behaviour must remain 100% identical. Only className, inline styles, Tailwind classes, Framer Motion props, and JSX structure for layout purposes may be changed.

typography.display_font: 'Anton', sans-serif — import from Google Fonts. Use for all hero headlines, section titles, stat numbers. All caps inherently. This font IS the personality.
typography.body_font: 'Libre Baskerville', serif — import from Google Fonts. Use for body copy, testimonial quotes, FAQ answers. The serif creates the match-programme editorial feel.
typography.ui_font: 'DM Sans', sans-serif — import from Google Fonts. Use for navigation, labels, buttons, badges, pricing details, admin UI. Provides modernity to balance the editorial weight.
typography.mono_font: 'Courier Prime', monospace — import from Google Fonts. Use for live tickers, timestamps, admin data tables, score displays.
typography.tracking_ui: letter-spacing: 0.06em on DM Sans uppercase labels

motion.scroll_reveal: initial={{ opacity:0, y:24 }} whileInView={{ opacity:1, y:0 }} viewport={{ once:true }} transition={{ duration:0.6, ease:[0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94] }}.
motion.stagger_children: staggerChildren: 0.08 for grids and card lists.

tokens.radius_card: 0px — NO border radius on most elements. Hard edges. Match-programme geometry.
tokens.radius_button: 0px — pill shape only for badges: 2px radius.

global_rules.texture_overlay: Apply a paper grain texture using an SVG noise filter or a CSS background with a fine dot pattern at 2% opacity over all major sections — evokes newsprint, tactile warmth. Use: background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,...").
global_rules.ruled_lines: Horizontal rules throughout the design use border-top: 2px solid #1A1A1A. These are not dividers — they are editorial columns. Use them generously.
global_rules.section_numbering: Each major section has a typographic section number in Anton, 96px, color rgba(26,26,26,0.05), positioned absolute top-right — decorative watermark only.
global_rules.print_columns: Some sections use a CSS multi-column layout to mimic a printed spread — specifically testimonials and FAQ.
global_rules.live_dot: For any 'LIVE' indicator: a 6px circle in #D42B2B (red — not green, mirrors broadcast conventions) with a CSS keyframe pulse, 1.5s infinite.
global_rules.unexpected_move: The entire site uses LIGHT MODE — every competitor uses dark mode. This is the design statement. The white/cream base with black ink IS the brand differentiator. Do not add a dark mode toggle.

Nav.brand_wordmark: Font: Anton, font-size 24px, color #1A1A1A. 'KICK' with a green underline 2px #00A651 beneath just the K. 'STREAM' in #1A1A1A. Pure type, no icon.

framer_motion_upgrades.page_load: Wrap App.jsx in AnimatePresence. Route transitions: opacity 0→1, 0.25s.
framer_motion_upgrades.section_reveal: Each section: initial={{ opacity:0, y:24 }} whileInView={{ opacity:1, y:0 }} viewport={{ once:true, margin:'-60px' }} transition={{ duration:0.6, ease:[0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94] }}.
framer_motion_upgrades.headline_wipe: Hero words: use clipPath variants — initial={{ clipPath:'inset(0 100% 0 0)' }} animate={{ clipPath:'inset(0 0% 0 0)' }}. Stagger 60ms per word. This is the signature reveal.
framer_motion_upgrades.card_hover_editorial: All cards: whileHover={{ x:-2, y:-2, boxShadow:'6px 6px 0 rgba(26,26,26,0.18)' }}. No y-only movement — the diagonal shift reinforces the offset shadow aesthetic.

design_philosophy_note: This is a LIGHT MODE site in an industry of dark mode competitors. The editorial, printed aesthetic is the entire differentiator — lean into it fully. Every hard edge, every black rule, every serif body font is a deliberate statement: this brand has character. Resist any temptation to soften corners, add gradients, or introduce dark cards on the light base. The contrast IS the identity.
delivery_instruction: Apply every style change described above, component by component. Do not regenerate logic. Do not change any prop names, function names, variable names, or imported utilities unless they are purely styling utilities. Where Tailwind classes are used, replace with the new palette classes or inline style where Tailwind cannot express the value. Pay special attention to the hard border-radius: 0 rule and the offset box-shadow pattern on cards. Import all four Google Fonts in index.html. Add the Tailwind config extensions. Output each updated component file in full.
